.sp-skeleton-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.7rem 0;
  border-bottom: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
}
.sp-skeleton-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}

.sp-skeleton-num {
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 25%,
    var(--border-hover) 50%,
    var(--bg-surface) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: sp-shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

.sp-skeleton-thumb {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  flex-shrink: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 25%,
    var(--border-hover) 50%,
    var(--bg-surface) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: sp-shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

.sp-skeleton-content {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.45rem;
}

.sp-skeleton-line {
  height: 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 25%,
    var(--border-hover) 50%,
    var(--bg-surface) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: sp-shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

.sp-skeleton-line-full  { width: 100%; }
.sp-skeleton-line-80    { width: 80%; }
.sp-skeleton-line-55    { width: 55%; }
.sp-skeleton-line-40    { width: 40%; }

/* Skeleton cho Spotlight */
.sp-skeleton-cover {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 25%,
    var(--border-hover) 50%,
    var(--bg-surface) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: sp-shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

/* Skeleton cho Quote */
.sp-skeleton-quote-line {
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg,
    var(--bg-surface) 25%,
    var(--border-hover) 50%,
    var(--bg-surface) 75%);
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: sp-shimmer 1.4s infinite;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATTERN: RANKED — Bảng xếp hạng (chuẩn mockup 01, 02, 03)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.special-posts-ranked-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.sp-ranked-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem;
  border-bottom: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: var(--transition);
  position: relative;
}
.sp-ranked-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.sp-ranked-item:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

/* Số thứ tự to */
.sp-rank-number {
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  opacity: 0.35;
  min-width: 40px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  user-select: none;
}

.sp-ranked-thumb {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}
.sp-ranked-thumb img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.35s ease;
}
.sp-ranked-item:hover .sp-ranked-thumb img {
  transform: scale(1.06);
}

.sp-ranked-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
}

.sp-ranked-title {
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--text-main);
  margin: 0;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}
.sp-ranked-item:hover .sp-ranked-title {
  color: var(--primary);
}

.sp-ranked-date {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  font-weight: 400;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATTERN: SPOTLIGHT — Hero Card (Tiêu điểm bài viết)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sp-spotlight-card {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  display: block;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem 1rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.sp-spotlight-card:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.sp-spotlight-cover {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-surface);
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}
.sp-spotlight-cover img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}
.sp-spotlight-card:hover .sp-spotlight-cover img {
  transform: scale(1.04);
}

.sp-spotlight-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.sp-spotlight-badge {
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--primary);
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  padding: 0.2em 0.7em;
}

.sp-spotlight-date {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
}

.sp-spotlight-title {
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--text-main);
  margin: 0 0 0.55rem;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}
.sp-spotlight-card:hover .sp-spotlight-title {
  color: var(--primary);
}

.sp-spotlight-snippet {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin: 0 0 0.85rem;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.sp-spotlight-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.sp-spotlight-card:hover .sp-spotlight-cta {
  gap: 0.55rem;
  color: var(--primary-hover);
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATTERN: QUOTE — Trích dẫn / Chiêm nghiệm / Đoản thi
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sp-quote-card {
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  display: block;
  padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem;
  transition: var(--transition);
  position: relative;
}
.sp-quote-card:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.sp-quote-mark-open,
.sp-quote-mark-close {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 2.8rem;
  line-height: 0.7;
  color: var(--primary);
  opacity: 0.55;
  display: block;
  user-select: none;
}
.sp-quote-mark-open {
  margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
}
.sp-quote-mark-close {
  text-align: right;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

.sp-quote-text {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.75;
  color: var(--text-main);
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 0.4rem;
}

.sp-quote-author {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
  font-style: normal;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.sp-quote-divider {
  height: var(--stroke-hairline);
  background: var(--border-color);
  margin: 0.85rem 0 0.7rem;
}

.sp-quote-snippet {
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.55;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
}

.sp-quote-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.sp-quote-card:hover .sp-quote-cta {
  gap: 0.55rem;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   PATTERN: DIGEST — Bản tin vắn / Dòng thời gian mini
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sp-digest-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.sp-digest-item {
  display: block;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  padding: 0.8rem 1.1rem;
  border-bottom: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  transition: var(--transition);
}
.sp-digest-item:last-child {
  border-bottom: none;
}
.sp-digest-item:hover {
  background: var(--bg-surface);
}

.sp-digest-timestamp {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--text-light);
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.sp-digest-bullet {
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.sp-digest-title {
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--text-main);
  margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}
.sp-digest-item:hover .sp-digest-title {
  color: var(--primary);
}

.sp-digest-snippet {
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  display: -webkit-box;
  -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
  -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   EMPTY STATE & ERROR
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sp-empty-state,
.sp-error {
  padding: 1.5rem 1rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--text-muted);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.sp-empty-state::before {
  content: '📭';
  display: block;
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   ANCHOR HIGHLIGHT PULSE — khi bấm từ Header → #widget-{slug}
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
@keyframes sp-anchor-pulse {
  0%   { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.0); border-color: var(--primary); }
  25%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px var(--primary-light); }
  65%  { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.06); border-color: var(--primary); }
  100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(37, 99, 235, 0); border-color: var(--border-color); }
}

.special-posts-widget.sp-anchor-highlight .sp-widget-card {
  animation: sp-anchor-pulse 1.5s ease-out forwards;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   CONTAINER QUERIES — Tự thích ứng Sidebar (< 480px) / Main Content (≥ 480px)
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* ── Sidebar Layout: xếp dọc, width đầy đủ ── */
@container special-widget (max-width: 479px) {
  .sp-spotlight-cover {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 7;
  }
  .sp-ranked-thumb {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
  }
}

/* ── Main Content Layout: mở rộng sang dạng lưới ── */
@container special-widget (min-width: 480px) {

  /* Ranked & Digest → 2 cột grid khi có đủ chỗ */
  .pattern-ranked .special-posts-ranked-list,
  .pattern-digest .sp-digest-list {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
    gap: 0;
  }

  .pattern-ranked .sp-ranked-item,
  .pattern-digest .sp-digest-item {
    border-bottom: none;
    border-right: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  }
  .pattern-ranked .sp-ranked-item:last-child,
  .pattern-digest .sp-digest-item:last-child {
    border-right: none;
  }

  /* Ranked → số thứ tự to hơn */
  .pattern-ranked .sp-rank-number {
    font-size: 2rem;
    min-width: 48px;
  }

  /* Ranked thumb lớn hơn */
  .pattern-ranked .sp-ranked-thumb {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
  }

  /* Spotlight → layout ngang 60/40 */
  .pattern-spotlight .sp-spotlight-card {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr;
    gap: 1.1rem;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .pattern-spotlight .sp-spotlight-cover {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  }
  .pattern-spotlight .sp-spotlight-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  /* Spotlight title lớn hơn ở main */
  .pattern-spotlight .sp-spotlight-title {
    font-size: 1.2rem;
  }

  /* Quote → chia đôi khi có nhiều bài */
  .pattern-quote .sp-quote-list {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
    gap: 0;
  }
  .pattern-quote .sp-quote-card {
    border-right: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--border-color);
  }
  .pattern-quote .sp-quote-card:last-child {
    border-right: none;
  }
}

/* ── Rất rộng (≥ 700px) → chia 3 cột digest/ranked ── */
@container special-widget (min-width: 700px) {
  .pattern-ranked .special-posts-ranked-list,
  .pattern-digest .sp-digest-list {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  }
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   DARK MODE — hoàn toàn qua CSS variables, không cần override thêm
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
[data-theme="dark"] .sp-quote-mark-open,
[data-theme="dark"] .sp-quote-mark-close {
  opacity: 0.4;
}

[data-theme="dark"] .sp-rank-number {
  opacity: 0.25;
}


/* ==========================================
   AI TRANSPARENCY SYSTEM — FEAT-AI-TRANSPARENCY-V1
   Spec: specs/AI_TRANSPARENCY_SPECIFICATION.md
   Các biến thể huy hiệu:
     .ai-badge-full     → Trang Bài Viết Chi Tiết (Single Post)
     .ai-badge-standard → Post Card (Trang Chủ & Chuyên Mục)
     .ai-badge-micro    → Timeline Archive & Widgets
     .ai-badge-inline   → Nano inline trong ranked/digest
   ========================================== */

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   BASE: Lớp nền dùng chung cho mọi badge
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  background: var(--ai-badge-bg);
  border: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--ai-badge-border);
  color: var(--ai-badge-text);
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  white-space: nowrap;
  cursor: default;
  user-select: none;
  text-decoration: none;
  line-height: 1;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   VARIANT 1: FULL BADGE — Single Post Header
   Hiển thị: [ ✨ Hỗ trợ bởi AI ▾ ] với dropdown
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-badge-full {
  height: 26px;
  padding: 2px 12px 2px 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  gap: 0.3rem;
}

.ai-badge-full:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.ai-badge-full .ai-badge-chevron {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  opacity: 0.7;
  margin-left: 1px;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.ai-badge-full.is-open .ai-badge-chevron {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   VARIANT 2: STANDARD BADGE — Post Card Meta
   Hiển thị: [ ✨ Hỗ trợ bởi AI ]
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-badge-standard {
  height: 22px;
  padding: 1px 9px;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
}

.ai-badge-standard:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.2);
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   VARIANT 3: MICRO BADGE — Timeline Archive
   Hiển thị: [ ✨ AI ]
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-badge-micro {
  height: 18px;
  padding: 1px 7px;
  font-size: 0.70rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
  background: var(--ai-micro-bg);
  border-color: var(--ai-badge-border);
  color: var(--ai-micro-text);
  gap: 0.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   VARIANT 4: INLINE — Ranked/Digest Widgets
   Hiển thị: ✨ AI (không border, không background)
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-badge-inline {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.2rem;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ai-micro-text);
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  height: auto;
  border-radius: 0;
  backdrop-filter: none;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   KHUNG THÔNG CÁO MINH BẠCH (AI DISCLOSURE BOX)
   Ngữ cảnh: Đầu bài viết Single Post
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.ai-disclosure-box {
  background: var(--ai-callout-bg);
  border: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--ai-callout-border);
  border-left: var(--stroke-bold) solid var(--ai-callout-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 0.9rem 1.25rem;
  margin: 0 0 2rem;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
}

.ai-disclosure-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.ai-disclosure-title {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--ai-callout-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}

.ai-disclosure-toggle {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.3rem;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ai-callout-text);
  opacity: 0.65;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-family: var(--font-main);
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.ai-disclosure-toggle:hover { opacity: 1; }

.ai-disclosure-toggle-icon {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease;
}

.ai-disclosure-box.is-open .ai-disclosure-toggle-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* Nội dung text (ẩn/hiện với animation) */
.ai-disclosure-body {
  overflow: hidden;
  max-height: 0;
  opacity: 0;
  transition: max-height 0.35s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, margin-top 0.3s ease;
}

.ai-disclosure-box.is-open .ai-disclosure-body {
  max-height: 400px;
  opacity: 1;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}

.ai-disclosure-text {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--ai-callout-text);
  margin: 0;
  padding-top: 0.65rem;
  border-top: var(--stroke-hairline) solid var(--ai-callout-border);
}

.ai-disclosure-text p {
  margin: 0 0 0.55rem;
}
.ai-disclosure-text p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.ai-disclosure-learn-more {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--ai-callout-border);
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-top: 0.65rem;
  transition: opacity 0.2s;
}
.ai-disclosure-learn-more:hover { opacity: 0.75; text-decoration: underline; }

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   TÍCH HỢP VÀO ARCHIVE TIMELINE
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.archive-post-card {
  /* Cho phép badge căn chỉnh trong layout */
  align-items: center;
}

/* ──────────────────────────────────────────
   RESPONSIVE: MOBILE
   Co gọn Micro Badge chỉ còn icon trên mobile
   ────────────────────────────────────────── */
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  /* Archive timeline: ẩn text "AI", chỉ giữ icon */
  .archive-post-card .ai-badge-micro .ai-badge-label {
    display: none;
  }

  .archive-post-card .ai-badge-micro {
    padding: 1px 4px;
  }

  /* Full badge ở single post: thu nhỏ */
  .ai-badge-full {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    padding: 2px 8px;
  }
}


/* Blogger Theme Designer Dynamic Bindings (Overrides defaults with Theme Designer values) */
:root {
  --bg-body: $(body.background);
  --bg-card: $(card.background);
  --primary: $(primary.color);
  --primary-hover: $(primary.color);
  --accent: $(accent.color);
  --text-main: $(text.main);
  --text-muted: $(text.muted);
  --font-main: $(font.family);
}
